spans.s: Licchavi (= Pali id.), or Litsavi (Suv), n. of a people, with capital Vaiśālī: Mv 〔i.254.15〕 (v.l. Le˚), 17 (in the sequel regularly ˚Le, q.v.); 〔ii.76.8〕; Divy 〔55.18 ff.〕; 〔136.8〕; Mmk 〔621.13〕; Litsavi (confirmed Tib.) Suv 〔13.1 ff.〕 Cf. Licchivi, Manu 〔10.22〕, and see Lassen IA. 〔1.138 note 1〕.
